name: Salted lassi
description: Yogurt thinned with water, salted and spiked with roasted cumin.

ayurveda.note: Takra is ushna classically, though the drink is used to cool.

unani.note: Thanda-tar; the standard answer to a hot afternoon and a heavy plate.

nutrition.highlight: the answer to a hot afternoon

effects.note: Salted lassi is yogurt itself, thinned with water and salted, carrying the same live cultures credited with yogurt's own lactose-digestion effect — untested directly, but not a different food from the yogurt the trials used, just a savoury, more dilute serving of it. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
